title: Cartwise+ Membership Carried Waiver Share by Payment Steadiness
content:
On a Cartwise+ Membership carried-value refund, the share of the member fee waivers taken off follows how steadily the member has paid over the last twelve months.

**Ladder.**

- At least 10 fee charges captured in the last twelve months: a carried waiver share of 0.1.
- At least 6 and fewer than 10 fee charges captured in the last twelve months: a carried waiver share of 0.25.
- Fewer than 6: no share is set under this ladder.

| Fee charges captured on the membership in the last twelve months | Carried waiver share |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 0.1 |
| 6, 7, 8 or 9 | 0.25 |
| 5 or fewer | not set under this ladder |

## Questions on the ladder

**Which charges count?** Every fee charge captured on the membership in the window — first period, renewal, renewal retry and plan switch alike.

**How is the window counted?** In whole months ending today; a charge dated on the same day of the month twelve months back is not counted.

**What does the share apply to?** The member fee waivers received on the member's orders in the last month; the share multiplied by those waivers is rounded to the cent.

## Hypothetical illustration

A membership with 7 fee charges captured in the last twelve months and waivers of 4.20 in the last month: the share is 0.25, and 0.25 multiplied by 4.20 is 1.05. With 10 charges, the share is 0.1 and the amount 0.42.
